parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the member list. The value starts from 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of members per page in a paged query. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: StatType
parameters.description:
The statistics type. Valid values:
- ITEM: Statistics are collected based on individual review records.
- OPERATORCELL: Statistics are collected based on operation units. A single ITEM may contain multiple operation units.

parameters.name: TaskId
parameters.description: The job ID. For information about how to obtain a job ID, see [ListTasks](~~454662~~).

parameters.name: TenantId
parameters.description: Tenant ID. For information about how to obtain a tenant ID, see [ListTenants](~~454649~~).
